question: Which freedom is considered as the ‘Hallmark of Democracy’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Freedom of speech and expression.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The right to Freedom of speech and expression is guaranteed under the Constitution in Article 19(1)(a) 
 
• It is also considered as the ‘Hallmark of Democracy.
 
• Right to Freedom of Religion
 
 
• To all religions, there is equal respect given.
 
• It indicates the secular nature.
 
• There is freedom of profession, practice, conscience, and propagation of religion.
 
• Every person has the right to establish and maintain religious and charitable institutions, freely practice his or her faith.
 
• The State has no religion (official).
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• There are 6 fundamental rights of the Constitution are following

 
 
• Right to Equality - Article 14-18
 
• Right to Freedom - Article 19-22
 
• Right against Exploitation - Article 23-24
 
• Right to Freedom of Religion - Article 25-28
 
• Cultural and Educational Rights - Article 29-30
 
• Right to Constitutional Remedies - Article 32
